defect: ParamsToString shows 'Sample Size' when extra_info.sample_rate != 100, but the rate is a fraction defaulting to 1, so every table scan prints a bogus 'Sample Size: 100.00%' entry.
reason: The fix changes exactly this added comparison to != 1, matching the != 1 test the same change wrote in GetData.

defect: The new AlterInfo::if_exists member is hard-coded to false in the constructor and never carried by the subclasses' Copy() (here ChangeOwnershipInfo::Copy), so a copied ALTER statement (query verification, prepared rebinding) loses IF EXISTS.
reason: The fix threads if_exists through this constructor line and ChangeOwnershipInfo::Copy; the flag-dropping copy protocol comes from this change, although it only became observable for ALTER SEQUENCE once a later commit (7b91a87) set the flag there.

defect: Dialect candidates are stored with best_num_cols instead of their own num_cols (wrong in the second, same-quote branch), NextChunk resets best_num_cols, and the sniffed column count derived from these values is wrong.
reason: Blame shows the emplace_back(..., best_num_cols) lines and NextChunk come from this change, and the fix replaces them with num_cols and drops the reset.

defect: WriteCopyStatement uses 'for (auto &info : info.options)', a loop variable that shadows the parameter it iterates over, which GCC 4.9 rejects (it resolves info.options to the not-yet-deduced loop variable).
reason: The fix renames the loop variable to copy_option to restore the GCC 4.9 build, and the loop was added by this change.

defect: After unifying persistent and transient segments into one tree, InitializeAppend casts data.GetLastSegment() to TransientSegment even when it is a persistent segment loaded by Initialize, so appending after reopening a database hits the assertion or appends into a persistent segment.
reason: Before the change the transient tree held only transient segments; the fix adds the missing check for a persistent last segment in exactly this function.

defect: PandasDataFrame::operator[] stores the owning result of getter(names[index]) in PandasColumn's non-owning py::handle, so the column object can be freed when operator[] returns and BindColumn then uses a dangling handle.
reason: The old loop kept the column alive as a py::object; the fix (#8321) turns the handle into an owning py::object, repairing the struct this change introduced.

defect: HandleStructExtractRecursive builds a single ColumnIndex by AddChildIndex on the top-level index, so for more than two nested struct_extract levels the deeper field becomes a sibling instead of a grandchild and the wrong sub-fields are projected.
reason: The fix changes this declared signature to a vector of indexes and rebuilds the nesting correctly in the cpp body that this same commit added.

defect: GetMetricAsString returns the raw extra_info, which PrintAllMetricsToSS writes inside JSON quotes without escaping, so profiler JSON output with newlines or quotes in extra_info is invalid (the previous code applied JSONSanitize).
reason: The fix wraps exactly this added return in JSONSanitize, restoring the escaping that the rework dropped.

defect: The new case-insensitive child-name check in CombineEqualTypes rejects merging an unnamed struct (e.g. a row tuple) with a named struct of the same shape, a regression for queries like [{t:'abc', len:5}, ('abc', 2)].
reason: Before this change names were not compared and the mix worked; the fix (#11467) exempts unnamed structs in exactly the condition this change added.

defect: ParquetScanInitGlobal compares col_idx to the exported constant COLUMN_IDENTIFIER_ROW_ID from inside the extension, which does not link on Windows; the extension must use IsRowIdColumnId.
reason: The fix replaces exactly this added comparison with IsRowIdColumnId, the helper introduced earlier because extensions cannot compare to that constant on Windows.

defect: The change accidentally added a duplicate copy of list_concat.cpp under extension/core_functions; the fix deletes it while adding the core_functions sources to the amalgamation and Python package build.
reason: The stray file was listed in no CMakeLists and the Python build did not compile core_functions at all, so it broke nothing at this change; the Python build failure came from core_functions missing from the package scripts, which predates this change.

defect: The change routes LOGICAL_EXCEPT into PullUpEmptyJoinChildren, whose D_ASSERT only allows comparison and any joins, so every EXCEPT query fails the assertion in debug builds (and join_type == JoinType::ANTI is a no-op comparison).
reason: The fix adds LOGICAL_EXCEPT to the assertion (plus a break) for the case this change introduced; both the new case and the assertion are in the diff.

defect: SniffValue starts each new value with value = current_char and then appends current_char again for STANDARD states, duplicating the first character (or keeping the quote), and it never collects quoted content.
reason: The fix resets value to empty and also collects quoted characters in this function, which this change added.

defect: LCMOperator returns left * (right / gcd) with its sign, so lcm of a negative and a positive input is negative instead of the non-negative least common multiple.
reason: The fix returns the absolute value in exactly the return line this change added.

defect: Inside namespace duckdb_chimp the debug-only member is declared as unqualified vector<uint8_t>, which does not name duckdb::vector, so DEBUG builds fail to compile.
reason: The fix qualifies it as duckdb::vector on the line this change wrote.

defect: PropagateStructExtractStats calls ->Copy() on struct_stats.child_stats[info.index] without checking for null, but StructStatistics can hold null child statistics, causing a null dereference.
reason: The fix adds the missing null check in this function, which this change added; that child stats can be null is visible in struct_statistics.cpp, which checks for it.

defect: The new rounding in HugeIntegerCastOperation::Finalize divides decimal by 10^decimal_total_digits (and the exponent paths use -e - 1 and exponent + 1 offsets), so the first fractional digit is always lost and casts such as '1.5' to HUGEINT no longer round.
reason: Blame shows the fixed lines are from this change, and the fix corrects the digit counts to -e and exponent and divides by 10^(digits-1).

defect: MergeDictionaries rewrites the dictionary SelectionVector in place, and in DataChunk::Slice that vector lives in the DictionaryBuffer shared with the source chunk after Reference, so slicing mutates the source vectors (and columns sharing a buffer get merged twice).
reason: The fix replaces the in-place merge with Vector::Slice, which creates a new dictionary buffer per slice through a cache; that Reference shares the buffer needs vector.cpp.

defect: When lambda_bindings is null the binder points the member at the function-local local_bindings and never resets it, leaving a dangling pointer for later lambdas once the function returns.
reason: The fix resets lambda_bindings to nullptr when the outermost lambda's bindings are popped, repairing the pointer this change introduced.

defect: The children list of SetOperationNode is gated on ShouldSerialize(6), but serialization version 6 is the already released v1.4.0, so targeting v1.4.0 writes the new children-only form (left/right null) that v1.4.0 cannot read back correctly.
reason: Before this change two-child nodes were always written as left/right; the fix bumps the generated check to 7 after adding v1.5.0 to version_map.json (the hand-written SerializeChildList was later bumped to 7 as well).

defect: row_start is skipped when ShouldSerialize(6), but 6 is the released v1.4.0 serialization version, so data written for v1.4.0 compatibility omits row_start, which v1.4.0 readers then default to 0.
reason: The generated condition added here used 'latest' = 6 because version_map.json had no unreleased version; the fix maps v1.5.0/latest to 7 and changes this line to ShouldSerialize(7).
